tables.expense_categories: CREATE TABLE `expense_categories` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`name` varchar(150) NOT NULL,`name_key` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,`employee_based` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,CONSTRAINT `expense_category_flag` CHECK (`employee_based` IN (0,1)),`active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,`version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,`updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `expense_categories_name` (`name_key`),CONSTRAINT `expense_categories_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `expense_categories_state` CHECK (`active` IN (0,1) AND `version`>0)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.employees: CREATE TABLE `employees` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`name` varchar(150) NOT NULL,`name_key` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,`designation` varchar(150) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',`phone` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',`notes` varchar(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',`active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,`version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,`updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `employees_name` (`name_key`),CONSTRAINT `employees_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `employees_state` CHECK (`active` IN (0,1) AND `version`>0)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.expense_master_audit: CREATE TABLE `expense_master_audit` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`entity` enum('CATEGORY','EMPLOYEE') NOT NULL,`entity_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`version` int NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`action` enum('CREATE','UPDATE') NOT NULL,`snapshot` longtext NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `expense_master_version` (`entity`,`entity_id`,`version`),CONSTRAINT `expense_audit_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `expense_snapshot_json` CHECK (json_valid(`snapshot`))) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.expense_schema_receipts: CREATE TABLE `expense_schema_receipts` (`id` int NOT NULL,`version` varchar(32) NOT NULL,`plan_hash` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,`reference` varchar(150) NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),CONSTRAINT `expense_receipt_one` CHECK (`id`=1)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
